target: Instrumented isolated desktop with native macOS input

cases.title: New Spell through native shortcut and button
cases.expected: Command-Shift-N and the corner button create distinct empty documents and visible tabs.

cases.title: Both search shortcuts and physical glossary drag
cases.expected: Each shortcut opens Quick Node Search; dragging Text from results creates exactly one text node; Undo restores the empty graph.

cases.title: Physical output-to-input wire gesture
cases.expected: Dragging a source output to a local effect input creates the requested edge; one Undo removes it and Redo restores it.

cases.title: D shortcut bypass and restore
cases.expected: Selecting a local effect and pressing D toggles its bypass state, then restores it without changing another node.

cases.title: Node movement is one Undo gesture
cases.expected: One physical drag changes the intended node position; one Undo restores that position and a second Undo reverses the earlier separate marker edit.

cases.title: Float and redock a populated Spellbook
cases.expected: A visible Float/Detach control floats the Spellbook panel; physical native title-bar redocking preserves the document, nodes, edges, parameters and layout.
